verdict.rationale: Wise docs explicitly state cards can be issued worldwide and used to 'pay and withdraw cash worldwide without any hidden fees or markups,' directly matching the founder's story. Community evidence corroborates general reliability but doesn't specifically address card fee transparency, and there's no independent hands-on verification of the no-hidden-fee claim for card withdrawals abroad. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of actual ATM withdrawal fees and card FX markup transparency in practice.
